title: A Special Visit to London
passage: Dear Leslie, guess what? I'm coming to visit you for your special day. I'm really looking forward to celebrating with you. In fact, I'll be there for a few days. I've really missed you since you moved to London. As well as marking the day you were born, I can't wait to see the famous places in your new city. Just to let you know, I already bought my ticket and I'll be arriving a few days before your party. I will be staying at the Aldewitch Hotel. Have you heard of it? Once I have arrived, I will give you a call. I know you have to work, so I'll get myself a public transportation ticket to discover the city. It's going to be great. Let me know if you want me to bring you anything from home. I'm really excited about seeing you. Love, Jonah.
